result.title: A Transferable Pretrained 3D Model for Impedance Inversion with Sparse-Well Prior Conditioning
result.summary: Deep-learning-based seismic impedance inversion commonly requires retraining for each target survey, which may generalize poorly beyond the conditioning locations when well control is extremely sparse. We propose a transferable three-dimensional inversion framework that separates offline learning from target-survey deployment. A masked autoencoder first learns seismic structural representations from unlabeled multi-survey data, after which the frozen encoder is incorporated into an inversion network trained on synthetic geological models with sparse-well-derived low-frequency priors. During deployment, the complete inversion network remains fixed; the available conditioning well is used only to construct the low-frequency prior and align the global impedance range. Experiments on the Overthrust model show that the proposed method achieves the lowest full-volume NRMSE and reduces the P95 trace-wise NRMSE from 0.1310 to 0.1074 relative to the best target-trained baseline, indicating fewer localized large errors under different well locations. In a field survey with one conditioning well and three blind wells, it reduces the mean blind-well NRMSE by 20.95% relative to the target-trained U-Net while maintaining the highest correlation. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework transfers useful impedance information beyond the conditioning location with low deployment cost and without retraining the inversion network.

AI.brief_summary: 提出可迁移的三维地震波阻抗反演框架：先用掩码自编码器在多工区无标签数据上学习地震结构表示，再冻结编码器训练反演网络，部署时仅用稀疏井构建低频先验并校准阻抗范围，不重新训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「冻结预训练表示 + 少量外部证据构建先验」的设定，可能与 LVR 中如何把稀疏视觉证据注入内部状态、并在不更新模型下保持细节这一问题形成概念类比，可作远域启发核查。
